reason: The cited evidence (E1) only states that IrOsPtPdRhRu catalyzes a 12-electron ethanol oxidation process, without providing any data or mechanism linking this to lattice disorder, isolated sites, or modulated adsorption. The key mechanistic premises are entirely unsupported by the cited passage.
premises: High configurational disorder in nanoscale PtPdRhRuIrOs induces lattice distortions that create isolated, electronically perturbed metal sites.
These isolated sites modulate the adsorption strength of ethanol oxidation intermediates.
Modulated adsorption favors a complete 12-electron oxidation pathway.
Reducing disorder (via annealing) will reduce these electronic effects and shift the pathway to a less complete oxidation.
